subject: Electrical Engineering
title: Truth Tables: Mapping Every Possibility
description: Learn Truth Tables: Mapping Every Possibility in one minute.

hook.text: A truth table lists every possible input combination and its output. No ambiguity.

buildup.text: Two inputs give four rows. Three inputs give eight. N inputs give 2^N rows.

discovery.text: From a truth table, you can derive the exact Boolean expression for any logic function.

twist.text: Karnaugh maps group adjacent rows to simplify expressions — fewer gates, cheaper circuits.

climax.text: Every digital circuit begins as a truth table before it becomes transistors on silicon.

punchline.text: List every input. Write every output. The truth table hides nothing.

quiz.question: How many rows does a truth table for a 4-input function have?
